description: The constructed existential–universal sentence is true exactly when there is a witness tuple for which its matrix holds at every universal tuple.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExistentialUniversalSentences.sentence_realize.{u_1} (c : ℕ) (arities : List ℕ)
  {M : Type u_1} [(Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExistentialUniversalSentences.lang c arities).Structure M] {m n : ℕ}
  (φ : (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExistentialUniversalSentences.lang c arities).BoundedFormula Empty (m + n)) :
  M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExistentialUniversalSentences.sentence c arities φ ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExistentialUniversalSentences.MatrixTrue c arities φ
